tokens.name: bg-app
tokens.usage: App window background behind panels.

tokens.name: bg-panel
tokens.usage: Panels: sidebar, commit list, diff viewer, dialogs.

tokens.name: bg-raised
tokens.usage: Menus, popovers, the selected row, toolbar buttons at rest.

tokens.name: bg-hover
tokens.usage: Hover on rows and buttons, on bg-panel or bg-raised.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Dividers between panels and rows. Decorative only; never the only edge of a control.

tokens.name: line-control
tokens.usage: Borders of inputs, checkboxes and the stage checkbox in the diff gutter (3:1 on both panels).

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text and code, on every bg-* token and on add-bg/remove-bg.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text: authors, dates, file paths, hunk headers.

tokens.name: ink-faint
tokens.usage: Diff line numbers and placeholder text; still 4.5:1 on bg-panel.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: The one brand hue: primary button, selected item marker, focus ring, links, HEAD in the graph.

tokens.name: accent-soft
tokens.usage: Tinted background behind accent text: the current branch pill, an active tab.

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Text and icons on an accent fill (the primary button label).

tokens.name: add-bg
tokens.usage: Background of an added line in the diff viewer.

tokens.name: add-bg-strong
tokens.usage: Word-level highlight inside an added line; ink stays readable on it.

tokens.name: add-ink
tokens.usage: The + gutter sign, added-line counts (+12) and the add bar in file stats.

tokens.name: remove-bg
tokens.usage: Background of a removed line in the diff viewer.

tokens.name: remove-bg-strong
tokens.usage: Word-level highlight inside a removed line; ink stays readable on it.

tokens.name: remove-ink
tokens.usage: The - gutter sign, removed-line counts (-4) and the remove bar in file stats.

tokens.name: warning
tokens.usage: Conflicts and in-progress operations (merging, rebasing 3/7); as text on the bg-* tokens or warning-soft.

tokens.name: warning-soft
tokens.usage: Banner background for a conflict or a paused rebase.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Destructive actions only: discard, delete branch, force push. Text or the danger button fill.

tokens.name: on-danger
tokens.usage: Label on a danger button fill.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Focus ring, 2px outside the control; an alias of accent.

tokens.name: lane-1
tokens.usage: Graph lane colour 1 (lanes take 1-8 in rotation as they open).

tokens.name: lane-2
tokens.usage: Graph lane colour 2.

tokens.name: lane-3
tokens.usage: Graph lane colour 3.

tokens.name: lane-4
tokens.usage: Graph lane colour 4.

tokens.name: lane-5
tokens.usage: Graph lane colour 5.

tokens.name: lane-6
tokens.usage: Graph lane colour 6.

tokens.name: lane-7
tokens.usage: Graph lane colour 7.

tokens.name: lane-8
tokens.usage: Graph lane colour 8.

families.sans: Inter, "Segoe UI Variable Text", "Segoe UI", system-ui, sans-serif

styles.name: display
styles.usage: Empty states and the clone dialog title. Rare: at most one per screen.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Fix login redirect after token refresh
styles.usage: Default UI text: commit subjects, file names, menu items.

styles.name: body-medium
styles.usage: Emphasis inside body text: the current branch, button labels.

styles.name: small
styles.usage: Metadata: author, date, short hash, file stats.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Section labels in the sidebar and status tree, uppercase.

styles.name: code
styles.usage: Diff lines and file content. Row height is size row-diff.

styles.name: code-small
styles.usage: Hunk headers, hashes in commit detail, line numbers.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label gap, gutter padding.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Row horizontal padding, gap between pills.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Padding inside panels' headers and dialogs' fields.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Panel padding, gap between groups in a toolbar.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Dialog padding, gap between sections.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Empty-state padding.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Ref pills, checkboxes, small badges.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs, rows on hover, menu items.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Dialogs, menus, popovers, the window's inner panels.

tokens.name: shadow-overlay
tokens.usage: Menus, popovers and dialogs only. Panels never cast shadows: they are separated by line.

size.note: Fixed sizes the Rust layout code uses; rows are fixed height so lists can be virtualized.

tokens.name: row-list
tokens.usage: Status tree, branch list and menu rows.

tokens.name: row-graph
tokens.usage: Commit graph rows.

tokens.name: row-diff
tokens.usage: One diff line (matches code line height).

tokens.name: toolbar
tokens.usage: Top toolbar height.

tokens.name: sidebar
tokens.usage: Default sidebar width (resizable 200-360px).

tokens.name: lane
tokens.usage: Width of one commit-graph lane column.
